usageNotes: Returns all sendmail notification endpoints configured at the cluster level, including both user-created and built-in entries. Requires either Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit on /mapping/notifications — read-only audit access is sufficient. Use this to inventory available sendmail targets before creating or updating notification matchers.

examples.summary: List all sendmail endpoints to find active recipient targets

tips: The 'origin' field distinguishes user-created endpoints from Proxmox built-ins (builtin) and user-modified built-ins (modified-builtin) — only user-created entries can be freely deleted.
An endpoint with 'disable: true' will silently drop notifications; check this field when troubleshooting missing alerts.
Recipients can be specified as raw email addresses (mailto) or PVE user IDs (mailto-user); both fields may be populated simultaneously on a single endpoint.
This endpoint covers only sendmail-type endpoints; use the sibling gotify, smtp, or webhook list endpoints for other notification channels.
